messages:
Zoe: Tiny heads-up  friend dropping by at 4:30 with a surprise birthday cake (tiered, fragile) and a small handheld fog machine for a silly photo. Also noticed a parcel from ParcelPro on Returns E2 addressed only to 'Studio' with no team. Where's best to park the cake without it melting, and can reception pre-print a badge?
Ravi: Cake  put it in the fridge in the kitchen but on the top shelf and in a box if possible. If it's large, Secure Fridge S1 works. Fog machine  avoid indoor charging and keep off carpets.
Diego (reception): I can pre-print "Zoe guest" badge and add note "escort to West Balcony or Makerspace (vote)". I'll hold the ParcelPro package at desk until it's claimed.
Nia (facilities): If it's warm out, the balcony gets direct sun. Better to store cake in Secure Fridge S1 (in kitchen). I'll reserve S1 from 4:15-5:15. Fog machine: please don't use near smoke detectors.
Chris (mail): ParcelPro scanned: 3:58pm. Location: Returns E2. Item: 1x "crate" labeled "Studio". No recipient on barcode. I'll tag it "Studio - unclaimed" and move to Secure Shelf ST2 after EOD if unclaimed.
MailBot: Delivery scanned: "ParcelPro"  Returns E2  Action: Hold for 48h then route to Studio Ops if unclaimed. (automated)
Eve: Quick poll  West Balcony (sunny, photos) or Makerspace (indoor, plugs, better for fog machine)? Reply with :one: for Balcony, :two: for Makerspace.
Zoe: Balcony would be cutest for photos but if fog machine is risky maybe Makerspace. Leaning :one: but fine with :two: for safety.
Ravi: :two: Makerspace. Safer for the machine and has a tarp. Also access to vacuum if crumbs happen.
Diego (reception): Badge queued: "Zoe guest - 4:30 - escort". I'll add sticky: "cake - fridge S1".
Nia (facilities): I've placed a clean cardboard tray and a cooling mat in Secure Fridge S1 at 4:10pm. Tagged "Zoe cake". Also put a plastic bin for the fog machine if they want to leave it.
Chris (mail): Parcel labeled and photo posted to #people-ops so Studio folks can claim. If nobody claims by tomorrow morning I'll move crate to ST2.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder: do not operate fog or haze devices indoors without Facilities sign-off. Submit form in #safety-ops to request exception. (automated)
Eve: Poll so far: Balcony 1, Makerspace 2. Makerspace wins for safety. Zoe  want me to reserve Makerspace 4:20-5:00?
Zoe: Yes please reserve Makerspace. Diego  thanks for the badge. Nia  appreciate the fridge setup. Chris  thanks for holding the parcel. All set  cake and photos later! :tada:
